Job Description 
Are you an experienced Senior Backend Kotlin Engineer looking for a challenging project where you can work on scalable, business-critical applications? For one of our clients in Amsterdam, Morgan Black is looking for an experienced Kotlin Engineer to join a professional Agile/Scrum team. 
In this role, you will focus on developing, improving and maintaining high-performance backend services using Kotlin, Java, Spring Boot and event-driven architectures . You will work on complex systems that process large volumes of transactions, where reliability, scalability and performance are essential. 
You will collaborate closely with other engineers and stakeholders, translate business requirements into technical solutions and contribute to architectural decisions. 
What makes this project interesting? - Technical challenges: Work on high-volume, business-critical backend systems where scalability, resilience and performance are key. - Ownership & impact: Take responsibility for technical solutions and contribute to architectural decisions within an experienced engineering team. 
Job Requirements - Minimum 5 years of professional experience with Java and/or Kotlin; - Strong experience with Kotlin, Spring Boot and event-driven architectures ; - Experience with asynchronous communication using Kafka, RabbitMQ or similar technologies; - Strong understanding of REST API architecture and backend development; - Experience with PostgreSQL, MongoDB or similar databases; - Familiarity with observability, monitoring, logging and alerting; - Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and user stories; - Professional working proficiency in English. 
Nice to have: - Experience with high-volume, business...

A job where you can work part time? Perfect! It’s possible in the warehouse of the best furniture store: Kwantum. You’ll get a salary of €15,60 per hour and the best colleagues. And, of course an awesome canteen to enjoy your colleagues and breaks in. Is this your new job as a part time warehouse worker at Kwantum in Tilburg? 🥳

What we offer
- Salary of €15,60 per hour
- Part time job in a fun warehouse
- Extra shift allowances
- A varied job
- Travel allowance of €0,14 per kilometer
- Fun colleagues and a luxury canteen!

Who you are
To keep the warehouse running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a warehouse worker:

- You’re available at least 2 days a week
- You can work in both day shifts and evening shifts
- You speak Dutch or English
- You’re physically able to lift heavy boxes of maximum 30 kg
- You have your own transport to get to Tilburg
- You're okay with the (youth) wages

What will you do
As a warehouse worker, you’ll get to know every department! Together with your colleagues, you make sure all customer and store orders are handled correctly. You’ll collect orders using a voice pick system. The best part? You don’t even have to walk that much, because you’ll mostly be driving around on an EPT truck! Nice, right?

You’ll also help out in other departments. For example loading and unloading trucks. Since Kwantum sells all kinds of products, from furniture to little candles, the work can vary quite a bit in how heavy it is. 💪

Where will you work
Not only the Kwantum furniture pieces are super cozy and comfy. The work atmosphere is too! You’ll work in a small team where everyone is equal. Whether you’re a warehouse worker or a team leader!

When you start working at Kwantum, you’ll get a proper onboarding period with personal guidance. So you’ll feel at home quickly! ✨

Are you looking for a dynamic job where you can use your technical skills and work in a friendly and collegial team? Then we have the perfect vacancy for you! We are looking for an Assembly Employee who works with the team to assemble high-quality products.

As our site continues to expand, these systems are becoming increasingly important to support future growth.

As a part-time mail carrier for PostNL in Overloon, you make sure everyone receives their mail on time. This job offers plenty of flexibility, as you can organize your working hours yourself.

Your day starts at the depot at the Baasestraat in Overloon, where you collect the mail for your delivery route. After sorting the letters, you hop on your bike and set off. You cycle through the streets of Overloon, delivering mail to the correct addresses. Along the way, you can enjoy the fresh air and have a chat with the people you meet.

We currently have a vacancy in Overloon for approximately 3 hours per day, from Tuesday through Saturday, totaling around 15 hours per week.

You can collect your mail from around 10:00 AM, and you are free to decide when to start your route, as long as all mail is delivered before 6:00 PM. This gives you the freedom to fit the job around your schedule.

Are you 16 years or older, do you speak Dutch or English, and do you enjoy working outdoors? Then apply now and soon you'll be delivering letters and cards throughout one of our local neighborhoods!

Anyone aged 16 and over can become a mail carrier. You understand that you are the face of the postal company and therefore work accurately and in a customer-friendly manner. You enjoy being outdoors, staying active, and working independently. As a mail carrier, you like being on the move and take pride in delivering mail that makes people happy.

What you need:

- A smartphone that you can use during work for communication and route planning;
- A sturdy bicycle with a metal luggage rack;
- Availability for approximately 3 hours per day, either in the morning or afternoon;
- Flexibility to agree on a work schedule that suits both you and the employer.

You work with scanners and sometimes a forklift. Working hours are flexible, and you can work either full-time or part-time. Together with your colleagues, you ensure that customers receive their orders on time. You need to work in 3 shifts; morningshift (7:00-15:30), afternoonshift (15:00-23:30) and nightshift (23:00-7:30). 

You are someone who likes to roll up their sleeves and enjoys working as part of a team. You value completing tasks neatly and on time. You are capable of working accurately and have no trouble standing or walking during your shift. You have a reasonable command of spoken and written English, enabling effective communication within the team. Logistics experience is a plus but not a requirement—you are a quick learner!

Mandatory requirements:

- You have at least a VMBO level of education/aptitude
- You speak and write English
- You live within 20 km of Lelystad

As part of a dynamic warehouse team, you will help ensure that packages are processed efficiently and delivered on time.

Your responsibilities will include:

- Sorting parcels and packages

- Unloading containers
- Preparing parcels for shipment

- Monday through Saturday
- Morning shift: 06:30 AM - 02:00 PM

- Hourly rate: €16.50 
- Contract with a guaranteed 28 hours per week
- Travel allowance from 10 km one-way distance. Up to a maximum of 60 km one-way distance
- Free transportation to work from various pick-up locations, provided by Amazon
- Opportunity to gain experience at one of the world's leading logistics organizations
- Friendly and international working environment

Where will you work?
Amazon is one of the world's largest e-commerce and technology companies, serving millions of customers globally. The company is known for its fast-paced logistics operations, innovation, and customer-focused approach. Employees work in a modern and dynamic environment where teamwork, safety, and continuous improvement are highly valued.

Are you interested?
Apply before November 15th 2026.

Do you have any questions about the vacancy? Please feel free to contact us at regioamsterdam@adecco.nl. We will be happy to help.

- Work schedule: Work 32 to 40 hours per week in fixed 2-shift schedules (06:00 - 14:00 and 14:00 - 22:00).

- Transport: Own transport (car, motorbike, or scooter) to reach IJmuiden.
- Languages: Good command of English OR Dutch.
- Experience: No diploma or previous experience required.
- Availability: Willing to work 2-shift schedules (06:00 - 14:00 and 14:00 - 22:00).
